title: Gateway
description: The gateway accepts clients and sends all their traffic through foreign exits; Russian addresses go directly, from the gateway's own address.

summary.containerUnknown: no data — run “Check status” under maintenance

warnings.noExits: There are no exits, so gateway clients have no internet. Add at least one exit.
warnings.noUsable: No healthy exits: clients stay without internet until an exit recovers or another one is added.

exits.title: Exits
exits.empty: No exits yet. An exit is a foreign panel server with AmneziaWG: gateway clients' traffic leaves through it.

add.title: Add exit
add.description: The panel creates a service client on the chosen server and brings up a tunnel to it on the gateway. The server's own clients and settings are not changed.
add.noCandidates: No suitable servers: you need a panel server with AmneziaWG installed that is not yet added as an exit.
add.hint: Weight sets the share of clients: an exit with weight 2 gets twice as many clients as one with weight 1.

problems.weight: Weight must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
problems.limit: The limit must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}, or empty.

edit.title: Exit “{{name}}”
edit.description: Weight and limit change only in the panel: the tunnel and the clients already on the exit stay as they are.

remove.title: Remove exit “{{name}}”?
remove.consequences: Clients going through this exit now: {{count}}. They will move to the other exits, then the tunnel on the gateway and the service client on the exit are deleted.
remove.left_one: After the move {{count}} client will be left without an exit and without internet: the other exits are full, or this is the last exit.
remove.left_other: After the move {{count}} clients will be left without an exit and without internet: the other exits are full, or this is the last exit.

errors.notFound: Server not found — it may have been deleted.
errors.addConflict: The exit was not added: the gateway or the exit has no SSH access, the exit has no AmneziaWG, it is already added, another task is running on it, or there are no free slots.
errors.invalid: Check the weight and the client limit.
errors.exitGone: Exit not found — it may already be removed.
errors.removeConflict: The exit cannot be removed now: another task is already running on it.

assignments.title: Clients and exits
assignments.description: Which exit each gateway client uses. A client without an exit has no internet; its traffic never bypasses the exit.
assignments.empty: No clients on the gateway yet.
assignments.stranded_one: Without an exit and without internet: {{count}} client. Assign an exit or add a healthy one.
assignments.stranded_other: Without an exit and without internet: {{count}} clients. Assign an exit or add a healthy one.
assignments.pinTrigger: Pin client {{name}} to the current exit

move.title: Move client {{name}}
move.description: The client moves to the chosen exit immediately: established connections drop and reconnect.
move.assignDescription: The client has no exit, so no internet. Choose an exit — the client gets it right away.
move.noTargets: There are no other active exits.
move.pinHint: A pinned client leaves the exit only if it fails and returns once the exit is healthy again.

errors.notFound: Client or exit not found — refresh the page.
errors.conflict: Not done: the exit is not active or has failed, the client is revoked, or the gateway is busy. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.notApplied: The exit is valid, but applying it on the gateway failed (SSH). Nothing changed — try again later.
errors.checkConflict: A check is already running, or SSH access is not set.

ru.title: Russia direct
ru.description: Gateway clients going to Russian addresses leave from the gateway's own address; all other traffic goes through an exit. The list of Russian networks is shared by all gateways and comes from RIPE; services behind a foreign CDN are not in it — add them as exceptions.
ru.noList: No list loaded yet: all client traffic goes through an exit.

upload.title: Upload a list from a file
upload.description: A fallback without access to RIPE: a RIPE export (delegated-ripencc) or one network per line, up to {{size}} MB. The checks are the same as for a downloaded list.
upload.tooBig: The file is larger than {{size}} MB.
upload.active: List accepted and active: version {{version}}, {{prefixes}} ranges.
upload.candidate: List received (version {{version}}, {{prefixes}} ranges) but it differs a lot from the active one: confirm it below.
upload.unchanged: The list did not change: it matches the active one (version {{version}}).
upload.rejected_one: {{count}} network that cannot be routed directly was skipped.
upload.rejected_other: {{count}} networks that cannot be routed directly were skipped.

candidate.title: A new list is waiting for confirmation.
candidate.text: Version {{version}}, {{prefixes, number}} ranges: it differs a lot from the active one (by more than 20%), so it was not sent to the gateways. Make sure it is not a source glitch, then confirm.

add.title: New exception
add.description: A network that goes directly or through an exit regardless of the list. Applies to all gateways.

hint.direct: Directly — a public network no larger than /16 that does not cover the gateway's or exits' addresses.
hint.tunnel: Through an exit — the network is subtracted from the direct list; larger than /8 is not allowed.

consequences.direct: The network will follow the general list again: if it is not there, its traffic goes through an exit. The change is applied on the gateways.
consequences.tunnel: The network will follow the general list again: if it is there, its traffic goes directly. The change is applied on the gateways.

errors.format: Enter an IPv4 network in CIDR form, for example 5.45.200.0/24.
errors.hostBits: The address has host bits set: enter the network address, for example 5.45.200.0/24, not 5.45.200.7/24.
errors.notPublic: Only a public network no larger than /16 can go directly: private, service and reserved ranges are not allowed.
errors.tunnelTooBig: A network sent through an exit cannot be larger than /8.
errors.coversServer: The network covers the address of the gateway or an exit server: such a route would cut the tunnels and management. Use a narrower network.
errors.listReserved: The list contains private or reserved networks, or networks larger than /12 — they cannot go directly. The list was not accepted.
errors.tooFew: The file has too few suitable records. Is it a RIPE export or one network per line?
errors.size: After merging there are {{prefixes}} ranges, but {{min}} to {{max}} are expected. The list was not accepted.
errors.rejected: The list was not accepted: check the file format.
errors.applyConflict: Cannot apply: there is no active list, SSH access is not set, or an apply is already running.
errors.updateConflict: A list update is already running.
errors.listGone: List not found — refresh the page.
errors.notCandidate: Only a candidate list can be confirmed: it may already be confirmed or outdated.
errors.overrideGone: Exception not found — it may already be deleted.
